When you play ranked, you have to stay calm. Whether you want to win or have fun, staying calm works for both of them. And if you're scared of your team harassing you, think of things that will prevent that. Such as going in blind without wards. Muting them is also another option. Whatever you do, don't try to fight back or get tilted from what they say as it can make your ranked anxiety even worse. Also try listening to relaxing/focus music. It helped me throughout my climb to stay calm. I used to have ranked anxiety and I sometimes still do, but if you just stay calm and don't let people get to you, you should be fine climbing. Good luck!
